# Legend Physiotherapy Ortho and Neuro Pain Management Clinic

## About
Legend Physiotherapy is a professional physiotherapy clinic located in Kothapet, LB Nagar, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded by Dr. Velpula Sai Sirish (B.P.T, M.Sc Sports London) with over 20 years of experience in ortho and neuro rehabilitation.

## Services
- Orthopedic Physiotherapy (back pain, neck pain, knee pain, shoulder pain, arthritis)
- Neurological Rehabilitation (stroke recovery, paralysis, balance and gait training)
- Sports Injury Rehabilitation (ACL tears, ankle sprains, return-to-sport programs)
- Post-Surgical Rehabilitation (joint replacement, spinal surgery, ACL reconstruction)
- Home Visit Physiotherapy (available across all Hyderabad areas)
- Clinic-Based Physiotherapy (state-of-the-art facility in Kothapet)
- Dry Needling and Manual Therapy
- Shockwave Therapy
- Laser Therapy
- Robotic Physiotherapy
- Spinal Decompression Therapy

## Conditions Treated
- Back Pain and Lower Back Pain
- Neck Pain and Cervical Spondylosis
- Knee Pain and Osteoarthritis
- Frozen Shoulder and Rotator Cuff Injuries
- Sciatica and Slip Disc
- Sports Injuries (ACL, meniscus, ankle sprains)
- Stroke and Paralysis Rehabilitation
- Plantar Fasciitis
- Tennis Elbow
- Hip Pain
- Vertigo and Balance Disorders
